calibration.aggregation: Use observed total divided by known planting count, retain historical range and sample size; do not silently override source evidence

rules: Do not equate a seed tuber, crown, tree, plant, square metre or row
Do not equate cobs with kilograms
Mature perennial yields should not be assigned to first-year plants
Yield uncertainty must remain visible in UI and optimisation
For a planting count, low/expected/high are multiplied by count only when basis matches
Provisional figures should be reviewed and calibrated after first growing season
